Post 1

ASX 200 barely moved — up 2.00pts to 8,795.20 — but underneath, Materials cratered 3.85% while Financials surged 2.21%. A flat index hiding a violent rotation. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🟢 Consumer Discretionary +2.57%, Financials +2.21%. 🔴 Materials -3.85%, IT -0.92%. Miners dragged one way, banks and retailers pulled the other. Two different markets, one flat number. #ASX #mining #banking

Post 3

ZIP collapsed 29.47% to AUD 1.460 — the session's ugliest print by a wide margin. Whatever hit buy-now-pay-later today, the market showed zero mercy. #ASX #fintech #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,738.10/oz, Silver AUD 77.18/oz. Precious metals holding firm in AUD terms even as Materials sold off hard — the AUD/USD at 0.7021 is doing the heavy lifting. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

Materials down 3.85% in a single session. Watch whether that selling extends Monday or was a one-day flush. Where do you see ASX Materials heading next week — dead-cat bounce or more downside? #ASX #mining #ausbiz
